item: ТЗ-97 Q2 in the commit (0fe6207): the ownership channel is stage 4/6 of the usual path (rusterm follow), and every gray governance row now carries the reason in words plus the command that closes it (rule P8). Chain closed by the core, not by a hint: follow 4/6 (ingest --source ownership) -> ownership_transaction -> insider_net_inputs_from_store -> the governance lambda in the snapshot builder -> colour in the table. Two defects fixed on the way: insider_net read its denominator through latest_snapshot_id, which only shows ready rows (ТЗ-90 A3), so the colour lagged one run on a fresh catalogue - the builder now passes the snapshot it is assembling; and the ownership branch never called _flush_spend, so stage 4/6 reported 0 requests.

The lag was measured as a pair, not argued: /tmp/rusterm-q2live (pre-fix live path) still holds insider_net gray no_data:ownership_without_market_cap with 5 deals and market_cap_total 4977637074759.26 in the snapshot of the same run, while /tmp/rusterm-nolag (same data, derived tables deleted, rebuilt offline) gives yellow on the FIRST build with lineage ownership:buys=30104,sells=20065,net=10039sh,window=365d,documents=2.
